criteria.evidence: web/tests/e2e/25-account-sessions.spec.ts reproduces the §8 state rows of sessions.md in Chromium against the live database: loading (the read is held by a route stub so the skeleton is observable), empty (one session hides the sign-out-everywhere button), data error with retry, no access (guest redirected to /login?next=/me/sessions), blocked (limited session leaves for /me/archived), and not found (another device closes the session between the read and the click, the row disappears with the already-closed notice). The same file also covers revoking another device, sign-out-everywhere with its confirmation dialog, signing out with both cookies cleared, and the noindex meta of §10. CI run 35553208928: the browser job went from 169 to 179 tests with skipped unchanged at 9 and passed rising from 160 to 170, so all ten new scenarios passed.

server/tests/session-schema-contract.test.ts builds the assembled SDL and asserts AccountSession has exactly id, deviceClass, browserClass, createdAt, lastActiveAt and isCurrent, that no field in the session contract matches ip/location/geo/country/city/coordinates/asn or contains useragent, that the device and browser enums match the classifier, and that the list hangs on AccountUser only so no root query returns another account's sessions. server/tests/account-sessions.test.ts serialises the resolver payload and asserts it contains neither the stored IP nor the raw Mozilla/5.0 string. The browser scenario asserts the same on the body of the real /api/graphql response.
